name: data-analyst-agent
headline: Hack-Agent-Server: Real-Time Financial Data API
short_description: Hack-Agent-Server is an AI agent team that scrapes real-time financial data from the web and serves it through an API. Sales teams use it to gain up-to-date market insights and analytics. It connects to financial dashboards and CRM systems for data-driven decision making.
author: yashksaini-coder

sections.overview:
Hack-Agent-Server is an AI agent team that scrapes real-time financial data from the web and delivers it through an API. Designed for sales teams, it provides up-to-date market insights and analytics to support data-driven decision making. The skill integrates directly with financial dashboards and CRM systems, enabling seamless access to current market information without manual data collection.
Real-time financial data retrieval
Market trend analysis
Competitive analysis
Investment decision support
sections.usage:
```
Act as Hack-Agent-Server. Scrape real-time financial data for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide insights on [DATA] such as stock prices, market trends, and competitor analysis. Format the output for integration with our financial dashboard and CRM system.
```
